environment.description: ECS Fargate service in private subnet (no IGW route) behind an internal ALB with mutual TLS configured via a custom trust store (arn:aws:elasticloadbalancing:us-east-1:123456789012:truststore/internal-ca-bundle/abc123). The ALB listener has 'MutualAuthentication' mode set to 'verify' with TrustStoreArn pointing to an internal PKI CA that only issues short-lived client certificates (24h validity) to registered service mesh sidecars via SPIFFE/SPIRE. Connection attempts without a valid client certificate signed by the internal CA receive HTTP 400 from the ALB before any traffic reaches the target group. Additionally, the Fargate task ENI security group only permits inbound from the ALB's security group (sg-0a1b2c3d4e5f) on port 8080, and the ALB's own security group restricts inbound to the VPC CIDR (10.0.0.0/8). No public-facing route exists to the ALB.

config.subnet: private (no internet gateway, no NAT for inbound)
